image_description: A guenon monkey sitting on a thick, textured branch in a forest setting. The monkey has a distinctive facial ruff of white and brown fur, a dark face with forward-facing eyes, and a slender body covered in grayish-brown fur. Its long tail extends behind it, resting on the branch. The background consists of green leaves and tree trunks, creating a natural arboreal environment.
